startAnywhere: Start with what matters to you
yourChoice: Be specific or leave things open for now. You choose the direction.
storyQuestion: What kind of story would you like to write?
ideaHint: An idea, a scene, a person, or a world you are still exploring is enough.
proposalBoundary: You decide which suggestions to keep. Unconfirmed content never becomes established worldbuilding automatically.
manualOfflineHelp: No AI interview, character profiles, volume outlines or worldbuilding required. Manual writing works offline.
useBlendedPlan: Use the blended plan (you can also rewrite it below)
aiReplyInputPlaceholder: Your answer, a new idea, or “I haven't decided yet”…
aiChangesSuggestedCurrentValuePreserved: AI suggested changes; the current value has been preserved
aiHelpRefine: Help me refine this with AI
allowPublicCoverMaterialUse: Allow use in public cover materials
previousAiTaskEnded: The previous AI task has ended; you can start it again.
unsavedEditsWaitForResponse: Your edits have not been saved. Wait until the response finishes, then save and exit.
ideaToGraduallyOrganizedProfile: Start with an idea, and your profile will gradually take shape here.
turnIdeaIntoStory: Turn your idea into your story
aiRespondingSettingEditingPaused: AI is responding · Setting editing will resume when the response finishes
storyIdeaExample: For example: A mail carrier nearing retirement receives a letter addressed to their future self, ten years from now…
aiOrganizeIdeasFirst: Have AI organize my ideas first
aiDisconnectedManualCreationAvailable: AI connects when needed. Ideas are saved locally; manual creation is also available.
adjustInterviewDepthAnytime: Adjust the interview depth at any time
fieldConfirmationOptionalCompletion: Confirm each item or leave it undecided. You don't need to fill in every field.
aiDevelopInitialWorldAndCharacters: AI develops an initial world and character plan
reviewPlanConfirmedFieldsOnly: The plan is for review only; only confirmed or locked fields are used when creating the project.
confirmedCreativeSettingsNotice: You can continue developing characters and the world after creation. Only creative settings confirmed by the author will be saved now.
incompleteSettingsRetentionNotice: items still need work and will remain TBD. AI candidates and conversation history will be kept in the creative profile.
confirmNovelProjectCreation: I have reviewed the confirmed settings above and agree to create the novel project
worldQuestion: What kind of world would you like to create?
worldHint: Describe the world you have in mind. AI will draft editable settings directly. Characters, plots, themes and literary analysis are not prerequisites.
worldIdeaExample: For example: a world of floating islands connected by trading ships. Start with its natural rules, geography and everyday life.
worldOptionalSettings: Length and interview settings (optional; decide later)
confirmWorldCreation: Create the world workspace using confirmed world settings only. Do not generate characters, plot outlines or prose.
